## Business

Mal Al Sham (مطعم مال الشام) — also known as Mal Al Sham — The Taste of Damascus — is a family-owned Syrian and Mediterranean restaurant in El Cajon, California. The restaurant was founded in 2018 by Mr. Ahmed Abu Ali, a Syrian immigrant who arrived in El Cajon with his family in 2016 after running a wholesale business in Syria. The restaurant exists to bring generations-old Syrian recipes to San Diego County.

### Location and contact

- Address: 388 E Main St, El Cajon, CA 92020, USA
- Phone: +1 (619) 401-1055
- Email: info@malalsham.com
- Website: https://malalsham.com

### Hours

Open seven days a week, 9:00 AM – 10:00 PM (Monday through Sunday).

### Features

## Menu

### Breakfast (served daily)

- Fool — fava beans with tomato, parsley, lemon, garlic, olive oil; choice of tahina or tahina with yogurt
- Fool with vinegar variation
- Msabaha — crushed fava beans, tahina, yogurt, lemon
- Fatteh — chickpeas over baked bread chips with lemon, garlic, tahina, yogurt, sautéed nuts
- Manakish — stone-baked flatbread with za'atar, cheese, or minced meat
- Mal Al Sham Falafel — twelve chickpea fritters with our spice blend ($10.99)

### Salads

- Home Salad — tomato, cucumber, lettuce, red onion, red cabbage, parsley, lemon, olive oil
- Chicken Salad — with grilled or shawarma chicken
- Fattoush — with baked pita chips and pomegranate paste
- Tabbouleh — fine parsley, fine bulgur, lemon, mint, olive oil
- Yogurt & Cucumber — house-made yogurt with garlic and dried mint
- Greek Salad — feta, croutons, vegetables, Greek dressing

### Syrian Kibbeh

- Fried Kibbeh — bulgur shells with minced meat and aromatic spices
- Grilled Kibbeh — same blend, finished over open flame

### Entrees

- Chicken Shawarma — rotisserie chicken with tahina sauce

- Hummus — stone-milled chickpeas, tahina, lemon, olive oil

### Weekend Specials (Friday – Sunday and holidays only)

- Mansaf — slow-cooked lamb over short rice, parsley, sautéed nuts, jameed yogurt sauce
- Ghouzi (Ouzi) — whole slow-roasted lamb over seasoned rice

## Story

In 2016, the Abu Ali family arrived in El Cajon, California from Syria. Mr. Ahmed Abu Ali had previously run a wholesale business in Syria. Driven by a passion for authentic Syrian cuisine and a desire to share Damascene food culture with the community, the family opened Mal Al Sham in 2018 on East Main Street. The restaurant has since become a local favorite, drawing customers from across San Diego County and earning more than 1,500 five-star reviews. The owner is often present on the floor and is known among regulars as "the dad" — a fixture who welcomes guests personally.
